summary: Welcome page for the playbooks guide: playbooks are YAML automation blueprints, and the guide covers privilege escalation, loops, delegation, conditionals, blocks, collections, roles, includes/imports and tags. Includes Red Hat's inclusive language note.
questions: What topics does the Ansible playbook guide cover?

answer_card.title: What the playbooks guide covers
answer_card.answer_md: Playbooks are YAML automation blueprints Ansible uses to deploy and configure inventory nodes. The guide covers running tasks with elevated privileges or as another user, loops, delegation, conditionals and tests, blocks, collections, reusable files and roles, including/importing playbooks, and tags.
